title: Visteon Names Gary Hicok to Board of Directors
summary: Visteon Corporation (NASDAQ: VC), a global leader in automotive cockpit electronics, today announced the appointment of Gary Hicok to its board of directors, effective July 1. Mr. Hicok will serve on the Technology Committee of the board. "We are delighted to welcome Gary Hicok to Visteon's board of directors," said Francis Scricco, chair of Visteon's board. "Gary brings a unique combination of automotive, semiconductor and systems leadership experience gained over decades at the forefront of technology innovation. His leadership in building NVIDIA's automotive business and advancing complex computing platforms will provide valuable perspective as Visteon continues to accelerate innovation for software-defined vehicles and next-generation cockpit solutions." "Visteon's leadership in digital cockpit technologies, software-defined architectures and AI-enhanced solutions provides a strong foundation for growth," said Hicok.
